detail.longDescription: Hello Fediverse! Here is my # Introduction : Setting up an account and finding my footing. By nature, I am a quiet observer and prefer reading, learning, and following thoughtful feeds over posting. Topics I enjoy following: • # Electronics & electrical tinkering • # Homelab & # SelfHosted infrastructure • # Music , guitar & composing # TTRPG scores • Hands-on building & maker craft Happy to read and learn from the community. Feed recommendations are welcome!
